channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Incoming House majority leader Katherine Clark stresses Democratic unity
item.description: As Democrats prepare to take control of the House, incoming majority leader Katherine Clark discusses the party's ambitious agenda and divisions within its ranks.

item.title: As some states move away from the death penalty, Florida prepares to set new record
item.description: Florida is set to have its 20th execution of the year Thursday. It's a new record, as other states are moving away from the death penalty.

item.title: After 13-year wait, Grand Theft Auto VI hits store shelves
item.description: Millions of gamers are picking up Grand Theft Auto VI, the latest in a best-selling video game series -- many even taking time off work to play. We explore what makes the game so popular.

item.title: International Court of Justice issues ruling on Myanmar genocide case
item.description: The court ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya Muslim minority – a landmark judgment that marks a turning point in international justice. Myanmar has denied the allegations.

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet as global alliances hang in the balance
item.description: President Trump, China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin have gathered in Shenzhen, China, for a historic trilateral meeting, with Ukraine, Iran and nuclear disarmament on the agenda.
